answer.reason: The requested indicator is the both-sexes modeled lower-secondary completion rate (CR.MOD.2). For Chile in 2023, the listed value for that both-sexes indicator is 95.66999816894533%; the 97.79000091552734% value corresponds to the female-specific counterpart, not the requested both-sexes value.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators table for the indicator 'Completion rate, lower secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%)', what value is listed for Chile (CHL) in 2023?

A. 97.79000091552734%
B. 95.66999816894533%

Source citation: UNESCO UIS SDG 4 Education Indicators: Completion rate, lower secondary education, both sexes (modelled data) (%) (https://data.unesco.org/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/uis001/records?where=indicator_id+%3D+%22CR.MOD.2%22+and+year+%3D+date%272023-01-01%27&order_by=country_id&limit=100&offset=0)

Supplied draft answer: A
